footprints.description: TE 166088 AMP-Edge board-to-board card-edge connector, 13 posts, 2.54 mm pitch, one row of through-hole posts

footprints.description: TE 1717831 mini PCI Express / mSATA card-edge socket, 52 contacts, 0.8 mm pitch, surface mount
